error.title: Opportunities could not load
error.body: Something went wrong reading this page. Try again; if it keeps failing, share the reference with support.

signing.issued: Signing link issued. Send the link and the code separately.
signing.once: This is the only time the link and code are shown; issuing another link revokes this one.

fields.name: Name
fields.question: Question
fields.title: Title
fields.isRemote: The work can be done remotely
fields.hideClientUntilBooked: Hide client and event until booked

fieldErrors.required: Fill in this field to continue.
fieldErrors.invalid: Check this value: it is not in the expected format.
fieldErrors.dneReason: Give the reason for Do Not Engage; it stays internal.
fieldErrors.dneReview: Set a review date for Do Not Engage.
fieldErrors.payNeedsRate: Choose Hourly, Day, Flat or Milestone to post a pay range.
fieldErrors.phone: That is not a phone number. Include the country code, for example +13105550100.
fieldErrors.invalid_rate: Write the rate as in the example, with no more decimals than its currency has.
fieldErrors.rate_currency_required: Add the currency: a code such as USD, or a symbol your organization's currency uses.
fieldErrors.rate_type_required: Say how it is paid, for example 250 per day, 25 per hour or 500 flat.
fieldErrors.rate_type_conflict: The rate and its type disagree. Keep one.
fieldErrors.hiddenClientNamed: While the client and event are hidden, remove the project, client and venue names from the title and description.
fieldErrors.hiddenClientPublished: This listing already showed its client and event. Hide them on a new posting while it is a draft.

errors.notFound: This record is gone or you can no longer see it. Reload the page.
errors.conflict: That already exists. Change the value and try again.
errors.invalid: One of the values breaks a rule. Check the fields and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong saving this. Try again in a moment.

refusal.generic: The change was refused by rule {rule}. Fix what it names and try again.
refusal.requisition_required: Your organization sets spend limits for requisitions, so Contractor, Crew and Staff postings publish only from an Approved requisition. Choose one, then publish.
refusal.requisition_not_approved: That requisition is not Approved yet. Get it approved under spend authority first.
refusal.requisition_mismatch: That requisition is for another project or role. Choose the matching requisition.
refusal.requisition_missing: That requisition was deleted. Choose another, or publish without one.
refusal.pay_range_required: This jurisdiction requires a posted pay range. Add the lowest and highest pay, then publish.
refusal.plan_feature_unavailable: Public marketplace listings need the Pro plan or above. Choose another visibility or upgrade.
refusal.opportunity_jurisdiction_unknown: Give the posting a venue or jurisdiction so pay transparency can be checked.
refusal.bid_deadline_required: A Bid posting needs a deadline; bids stay sealed until it passes.
refusal.opportunity_published_terms: Pay, visibility, deadline and requisition are fixed once published. Pause, close and post again to change them.
refusal.opportunity_removed: Moderation removed this listing. It can be published again only after it is restored.
refusal.opportunity_transition_not_allowed: The posting cannot move to that state from here. Pick one of the offered states.
refusal.opportunity_state_conflict: Someone else moved this posting first. Reload to see its state.
refusal.application_transition_not_allowed: The application cannot move to that state from here.
refusal.application_state_conflict: Someone else moved this application first. Reload to see its state.
refusal.offer_application_state: Offers go to applications In Review or Shortlisted. Review the application first.
refusal.offer_not_your_turn: The applicant has not answered these terms yet. Wait for their answer.
refusal.offer_expired: These terms expired. Send new terms instead.
refusal.offer_expiry_past: The expiry must be in the future.
refusal.sod_offer_self: You cannot send an offer on your own application.
refusal.offer_not_accepted: Accept the offer in force before accepting the application.
refusal.offer_transition_not_allowed: The offer cannot do that from its current state.
refusal.engagement_application_not_accepted: Only an accepted application becomes an engagement.
refusal.engagement_already_created: This application already has its engagement. Open it from Engagements.
refusal.engagement_role_required: Give the posting a canon role code before engaging from it.
refusal.engagement_work_terms: Client and sponsor engagements carry no role, classification or pay terms. Leave them out and try again.
refusal.onboarding_incomplete: Every blocking onboarding item must pass before the engagement is Active. Verify the open items first.
refusal.engagement_transition_not_allowed: The engagement cannot move to that state from here.
refusal.engagement_state_conflict: Someone else moved this engagement first. Reload to see its state.
refusal.engagement_document_transition_not_allow: The document cannot move to that state from here.
refusal.engagement_document_party_signs: Only the engaged party signs. Send the document or issue a signing link.
refusal.engagement_document_signed: A signed document cannot be edited. Issue a new document that supersedes it.
refusal.document_token_state: Send the document before issuing a signing link.
refusal.document_token_email: Enter a valid email address for the signing link.
refusal.document_token_validity: A signing link lasts between 1 and 90 days.
refusal.sod_onboarding_self_verify: An engaged party cannot verify their own onboarding. Ask another reviewer.
refusal.verification_automatic: This item is verified automatically by its integration.
refusal.pool_member_kind: Talent pools hold people and vendor pools hold accounts. Choose the matching pool.
refusal.pool_member_own_org: Your org cannot be a member of its own pool.
refusal.rating_engagement_not_complete: Ratings come only from completed engagements.
refusal.rating_not_released: You can reply once both ratings are released.
refusal.sod_rating_self: You cannot rate your own engagement for the org.
refusal.deliverable_return_reason: Say why the work is returned so the party can fix it.
refusal.sod_deliverable_self: The person who handed in the work cannot accept it.
refusal.deliverable_transition_not_allowed: The deliverable cannot move to that state from here.
refusal.XOS_ENG_1: This classification needs a pay basis, or an unpaid classification has none. Adjust the pay basis.
refusal.XOS_ENG_2: Employee engagements need an employment status and FLSA status.
refusal.XOS_ENG_3: Employment status, FLSA status and labor agreements apply only to employees.
refusal.XOS_ENG_4: Vendor-supplied engagements must name the vendor's account.
refusal.XOS_ENG_5: The overtime rule is below the legal minimum here. Choose a rate card that meets it.
refusal.XOS_ENG_6: Your organization type does not permit that worker classification.
refusal.plan_limit_exceeded: Your plan's monthly limit of external engagements is reached. Upgrade or wait for next month.
refusal.transition_reason_required: Give a reason for the change.
refusal.insureds_none_required: The organization requires no additional insureds for this project. Add them under Vendors, Insurance certificates, Required insureds.
refusal.insureds_vendor_only: Additional insureds are checked for vendors. This party is not a vendor of the organization.
refusal.question_template_not_found: That question template was deleted or is not available to you. Choose another template.
refusal.question_template_not_draft: A question template applies only to a Draft posting. Add questions one at a time instead.
refusal.registration_page_pool: A registration page fills a live Talent pool of the organization. Choose one.
refusal.registration_page_slug_fixed: A page keeps its address once it has opened. Close it and open a new one.
refusal.registration_page_minimum_age_fixed: A page keeps its minimum age once it has opened. Close it and open a new one.
refusal.registration_page_not_draft: Questions change only while the page is Draft. Close it and start a new page to ask other questions.
refusal.registration_page_closed: Open the page before inviting people to it.
refusal.registration_question_fixed: A question stays on its page.
refusal.registration_not_found: This registration no longer exists or is not available to you. Reload the page.
refusal.sod_registration_self: You cannot approve or decline your own registration. Ask another pool manager.
refusal.registration_not_submitted: Only a Submitted registration is approved or declined. Reload the page.
refusal.registration_person_excluded: This person is flagged Do Not Engage in a pool of the organization, so they cannot be approved.
refusal.registration_decide_batch: Decide 1 to 200 registrations at a time.
refusal.registration_invite_limit: Invite at most 1000 people at a time. Narrow the pool or leave out past crew.
refusal.document_template_fields: That text names a merge field that does not exist. Choose one from the list.
refusal.document_template_kind: A template generates an Agreement, a Statement of Work or a Non-Disclosure Agreement.
refusal.document_template_rate_title: A title is read by everyone who reads engagements, so it cannot use the rate. Put the rate in the body.
refusal.document_template_in_use: Documents were generated from this template, so its wording is fixed. Duplicate it to change the wording.
refusal.document_template_not_found: This template no longer exists or is not available to you. Reload the page.
refusal.document_batch_size: Generate 1 to 500 documents at a time.
refusal.document_batch_requirement: Choose a live Electronic Signature requirement of the organization.
refusal.document_batch_person: A document goes to a person's own engagement while it is Onboarding, Blocked, Active or Closing. A company engagement signs through the vendor.
refusal.document_merge_unresolved: Some merge fields were not filled. Fill them in the engagement, then generate again.
refusal.document_merge_rate_restricted: This template uses the rate, which needs the payroll capability across the organization.
refusal.document_batch_title: A merged title has 1 to 200 characters.
refusal.document_batch_body: A merged text has 1 to 200,000 characters.
refusal.document_batch_duplicate: This person already has a live document from this template.
refusal.document_batch_no_item: This engagement has no onboarding item for that requirement.
refusal.document_text_signed: The text is frozen once the document has been sent. Cancel it and generate a new one.
refusal.document_text_fixed: A text stays with its document and batch.
refusal.document_text_sign_with_hash: This document is read and signed in Gateway, so it has no signing link.
refusal.pool_invitation_pool: Invite people into a live Talent pool of the organization.
refusal.pool_invitation_phone: Enter the work phone in international format, for example +13105550100.
refusal.pool_invitation_duplicate: This address already has a pending invitation to the pool. Reissue it instead.
refusal.pool_invitation_declined: This address declined an invitation in the last 12 months, so it is not invited again.
refusal.pool_invitation_daily_limit: This organization reached 2,000 invitation emails in 24 hours. Try again tomorrow.
refusal.pool_invitation_fixed: An invitation keeps its pool, address and inviter. Revoke it and invite again.
refusal.pool_rate_not_permitted: Setting a standing rate needs the payroll capability across the organization. Leave it blank.
refusal.pool_rate_invalid: A standing rate is Hourly, Day or Flat, an amount of zero or more and a currency.
refusal.invite_expiry_range: An invitation stays open for 1 hour to 30 days.
refusal.invitation_closed: This invitation was answered or revoked. Invite the address again instead.
refusal.opportunity_hidden_client_named: While the client and event are hidden, the title and description cannot name the project, its client or the venue. Remove the name, or show the client and event.
refusal.opportunity_hidden_client_published: This listing already showed its client and event, so they can no longer be hidden. Post a new opportunity to hide them.

errors.insuredsMissing: Recorded as failed. No current certificate names: {rule}. Ask the vendor for an updated certificate.
errors.questionsNotApplied: The draft is saved, but the template's questions were not added. Open the draft and add them there.

requisitions.title: Requisitions
requisitions.empty: No requisitions yet. Raise one in People, get it approved, then post it here.

postings.title: Postings
postings.empty: No postings yet. Post an opportunity from an approved requisition.
postings.created: Draft saved. Open it to add positions, then submit it for approval.
postings.requisitionHelp: Required to publish {types} postings when your organization sets spend limits for requisitions; spend authority runs on the requisition.
postings.titleHelp: A Title Case noun phrase, for example Festival Riggers.
postings.roleCodeHelp: The canon role from the Roles Library, for example 5000.51.02. Required to engage from the posting.
postings.visibilityHelp: Invited shows only to named parties; Pool to your pools; Network to anyone you completed an engagement with; Public to the whole marketplace.
postings.payHelp: In major units, for example 950.00. Leave both blank for Rate on Request.
postings.counts: {positions, plural, one {# position} other {# positions}} · {applications, plural, one {# application} other {# applications}}
postings.applicationsCount: {count, plural, =0 {No applications} one {# application} other {# applications}}
postings.noDescription: No description yet. Describe the work so applicants know what they are applying for.
postings.noPositions: No positions yet. Add one per opening, with its call time.
postings.noRequirements: No requirements. Add insurance minimums or equipment the work needs.
postings.noQuestions: No questions. Add questions about the work; never ask for protected attributes.
postings.questionHelp: Ask about the work only, never protected attributes.
postings.noInvitationsInvited: Nobody is invited yet. An Invited posting shows only to the people and accounts you invite.
postings.noInvitations: No invitations. Invite parties to make sure they see this posting.
postings.noKnownParties: Invitations go to people and accounts you have engaged or received applications from.
postings.questionTemplateHelp: Its questions are copied into the draft, where you can change or remove them.
postings.hideClientHelp: Crew see your organization, the city, the dates and the pay. The venue stays hidden, and the title and description cannot name the project, its client or the venue.
postings.hideClientLocked: The client and event can be hidden only before a posting is published. Turning this off stays available.

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.empty: No applications yet. Publish a posting so parties can apply.
pipeline.internalHelp: Internal: never shown to the applicant.
pipeline.noInterviews: None scheduled. Schedule one to meet the applicant.
pipeline.yourTurn: The applicant countered; answer with revised terms or accept.
pipeline.theirTurn: Waiting for the applicant to answer.
pipeline.noOffer: No offer yet. Send terms when you have chosen.
pipeline.offerNotYet: Offers go out once the application is In Review or Shortlisted.
pipeline.classificationHelp: Your organization's own decision; XOS records it and never makes it.
pipeline.engaged: Engagement created. Its onboarding packet is ready.
pipeline.engageNeedsWrite: Someone with engagement write access creates the engagement.

shared.title: Shared with you
shared.none: The applicant shared no profile fields with your organization.
shared.loadFailed: What the applicant shared could not be loaded. Reload the page.
shared.sharedOn: Shared when applying, {date}. This is the snapshot the applicant consented to.
shared.revoked: Shared {date}, since revoked. Your organization keeps this snapshot only as the law requires.

pools.title: Pools
pools.created: Pool created. Add people or accounts you have worked with.
pools.empty: No pools yet. Create a talent or vendor pool to re-engage people you trust.
pools.internal: Pools are internal. Standing, reasons and review dates never reach any external surface.
pools.noMembers: No members yet. Add people or accounts from your engagements and applications.
pools.dneHelp: Required for Do Not Engage; stays internal.
pools.noCandidates: Everyone you have worked with is already in this pool.

invitations.title: Invitations ({count})
invitations.caption: Pool invitations
invitations.label: Label
invitations.labelHelp: Your own name for them. It is cleared when they accept.
invitations.workPhoneHelp: With the country code, or a number in your organization's country.
invitations.rateHelp: Informational only. For example {example} per day. It needs the payroll capability.
invitations.noteHelp: Internal. The invitee never sees it.

onboarding.title: Onboarding
onboarding.validHelp: Leave blank when a verification never expires.
onboarding.created: Requirement added. New engagements of that role get it in their packet.
onboarding.queueEmpty: Nothing to verify. Items appear here when engaged parties submit them.
onboarding.noRequirements: No requirements yet. Add the documents, forms and checks each role must complete.

engagements.title: Engagements
engagements.empty: No engagements yet. Accept an application in the Pipeline to engage a party.
engagements.blockingOpen: {count, plural, one {# blocking item} other {# blocking items}}

next.onboarding: {count, plural, one {Verify # blocking item} other {Verify # blocking items}}
next.documents: {count, plural, one {# document awaiting signature} other {# documents awaiting signature}}
next.reengage: Add to a pool to re-engage

engagements.noOnboarding: No onboarding items apply. Add requirements on the Onboarding page.
engagements.noDocuments: No documents yet. Add the agreement or statement of work, then send it.
engagements.ratingsAfterComplete: Both sides rate once the engagement is Complete.
engagements.partyRated: The party rated your org {score} of 5.
engagements.partyRatingHeld: The party has rated; it shows once you rate too or 14 days pass.
engagements.ratingHelp: Public, never edited. Keep internal notes off ratings.
engagements.noPools: No matching pool yet. Create one on the Pools page.
engagements.poolNeedsWrite: Someone with pool access records re-engagement.
engagements.milestoneFee: Fee: {amount}. Self-billing bills it once the milestone is accepted.

ratings.title: Ratings
ratings.empty: No ratings yet. Ratings come from completed engagements.

marketplace.title: Marketplace settings
marketplace.publicOn: Your plan includes Public marketplace listings.
marketplace.publicOff: Public marketplace listings need the Pro plan or above. Invited, Pool and Network postings work on every plan.
marketplace.visibilityHelp: Each posting chooses its own visibility when it is drafted.
marketplace.noRules: No jurisdiction rule is loaded yet. Rules arrive as canon adds the jurisdictions; publishing checks them automatically.

ranking.skills: Match between the role and the person's skills.

marketplace.reportsTitle: {count, plural, =0 {Listing reports} one {# listing report} other {# listing reports}}

insureds.title: Additional insureds
insureds.loadFailed: The additional insureds could not be checked. Reload the page.
insureds.verified: Every required insured is named. The item passes.

templates.title: How new opportunities start
templates.description: New postings start from these defaults and the chosen question template. People creating a posting can change every value before they save it.
templates.loadError: The opportunity defaults could not be loaded. Reload the page.
templates.defaultsSaved: Defaults saved. New postings start from them.
templates.visibilityHelp: Limited by your marketplace visibility above. Publishing to Public also needs the Pro plan or above.
templates.currencyHelp: A three-letter code, for example USD. Leave blank to start in USD.
templates.windowHelp: Sets the application deadline this many days after a posting is created. Leave blank for no deadline.
templates.managersOnly: Only people who manage marketplace settings can change these.
templates.listTitle: {count, plural, =0 {Question templates} one {# question template} other {# question templates}}
templates.listHelp: Reusable sets of application questions. Ask about the work only, never protected attributes. Changing a template never changes postings already created from it.
templates.none: No question templates yet. Create one for the questions you ask on most postings.
templates.noQuestions: No questions yet. Add the first one below.
templates.created: Template created. Add its questions next.
templates.nameHelp: A Title Case name, for example Crew Call Basics.
templates.hideClientHelp: New postings start with the client and event hidden from crew until they are booked. Each posting can still change it before it is published.

registrationPages.title: Registration pages
registrationPages.created: Page created. Open it to add questions and publish.
registrationPages.empty: No registration pages yet. Open one so crew and volunteers can register to join a pool.
registrationPages.emptyReader: No registration pages yet. A pool manager opens them.
registrationPages.noPools: Create a Talent pool first, on the Pools page. A registration page fills one.
registrationPages.openCount: {count, plural, one {# open registration} other {# open registrations}}
registrationPages.questionHint: Ask about the work. Never ask about a protected attribute such as age, race, religion, disability or family status.
registrationPages.promptHelp: What you ask each person, about the work.
registrationPages.invited: Invitations sent to the people who can be reached.
registrationPages.includePastCrewHelp: People with a Complete engagement in the last 24 months.
registrationPages.slugHelp: The page address under your organization, in lowercase words with hyphens. It is fixed once the page opens.
registrationPages.poolHelp: Approved registrants join this pool. The page never shows its name.
registrationPages.minimumAgeHelp: 18 to 99. It is fixed once the page opens.

registrations.title: Registrations
registrations.decideFailed: Those registrations could not be decided. Reload and try again.
registrations.pickHelp: Choose who to approve or decline. Each person's answers are listed above.

agreementTemplates.title: Agreement templates
agreementTemplates.empty: No agreement templates yet. XOS supplies no wording: write your own or paste what your counsel approved.
agreementTemplates.name: Name
agreementTemplates.languageHelp: How merged dates and money are written.
agreementTemplates.titleHelp: Everyone who reads engagements reads this title, so it cannot use the rate.
agreementTemplates.pickerHelp: Adds it at the end of the text.

agreementBatches.title: Agreement batches
agreementBatches.empty: No agreement batches yet. Generate them from a project's Engagements tab.
agreementBatches.noTemplates: Write an agreement template first, on the Onboarding page.
agreementBatches.requirementHelp: Optional. Signing and countersigning complete this onboarding item.
agreementBatches.peopleHelp: People engaged on this project. A company engagement signs through the vendor.
agreementBatches.previewTitle: {count, plural, one {Preview for # person} other {Preview for # people}}
agreementBatches.missing: Missing: {fields}. This person is left out until those are filled.
agreementBatches.sentDone: {count, plural, one {# document sent.} other {# documents sent.}}

errors.input: Choose a template and at least one person.
errors.noneReady: Everyone has a missing field. Fill them in the engagements, then preview again.
errors.not-found: This template or project is gone. Reload the page.
errors.conflict: Someone changed this a moment ago. Reload and try again.
errors.invalid: One of the values breaks a rule. Check the fields and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

agreementBatches.textMasked: This text holds a rate you cannot read.
